source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (CCTV OR "video surveillance" OR "closed-circuit television") AND (city OR urban OR "public space")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(CCTV OR "video surveillance" OR "closed-circuit television") AND (city OR urban OR "public space"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("CCTV" OR "closed-circuit television" OR "video surveillance") AND ("public space" OR "city" OR "urban"))
